    "text": "Payment Gateway API v2. OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the MFS Payment Gateway. Base URL: https://api-gateway.mfs.internal/payments/v2. Service: mfs-payment-gateway deployed on mfs-pay-pod-01. Database: mfs_payments_db on pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal. Service account: svc-payment-api. Endpoints. POST /payments - Create a new payment. Request body: {amount: integer (minor units), currency: string (ISO 4217), card_token: string, customer_id: string, description: string, idempotency_key: string}. Response 201: {payment_id: string, status: 'pending'|'authorized'|'captured'|'failed', amount: integer, currency: string, created_at: string, fraud_score: number}. The endpoint first calls the fraud scoring API at /fraud/v2/score to evaluate the transaction risk. If fraud_score exceeds the threshold (0.85), the p

The endpoint first calls the fraud scoring API at /fraud/v2/score to evaluate the transaction risk. If fraud_score exceeds the threshold (0.85), the payment is declined. Card tokens are generated by the Token Vault API. Events are published to the txn-events Kafka topic. GET /payments/{payment_id} - Retrieve a specific payment by ID. Response 200: Full payment object including status, amount, currency, card_token (masked), customer_id, fraud_score, processor_response, created_at, updated_at. GET /payments - List payments with filtering and pagination. Query parameters: customer_id, status, currency, from_date, to_date, cursor, limit (max 100). Response 200: {payments: Payment[], next_cursor: string, total_count: integer}. POST /payments/{payment_id}/refund - Initiate a refund for a completed payment. Request body: {amount: integer (partial refund amount, optional), reason: string}. Response 201: {refund_id: string, payment_id: string, amount: integer, status: 'pending'|'completed'|'failed', created_at: string}. Refund events are published to the refund-requests Kafka topic. GET /payments/{payment_id}/transactions - List all transactions for a payment. Response 200: {transactions: T

shed to the refund-requests Kafka topic. GET /payments/{payment_id}/transactions - List all transactions for a payment. Response 200: {transactions: Transaction[], count: integer}. Each transaction includes type (authorization, capture, refund, chargeback), amount, status, and processor_response. Schemas. Payment: {payment_id, amount, currency, status, card_token, customer_id, fraud_score, description, processor_response, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at}.     "text": "Token Vault API v1. OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the MFS Token Vault. PCI DSS Level 1 compliant card tokenization service. Base URL: https://api-gateway.mfs.internal/tokens/v1. POST /tokenize - Tokenize a card number. Request body: {pan: string (card number), expiry_month: integer, expiry_year: integer, cardholder_name: string}. Response 201: {token: string (UUID format), card_last_four: string, card_brand: string, expires_at: string}. The PAN is encrypted via HSMClient.encrypt before storage. Original

g (UUID format), card_last_four: string, card_brand: string, expires_at: string}. The PAN is encrypted via HSMClient.encrypt before storage. Original PAN is never stored in any MFS database. Token is stored in mfs_payments_db on pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal. All tokenization events are logged to mfs_audit_db via AuditLogger.log_event. POST /detokenize - Retrieve original card data (restricted access). Request body: {token: string, purpose: string, requester_id: string}. Response 200: {pan: string (decrypted), expiry_month: integer, expiry_year: integer, cardholder_name: string}. This endpoint requires elevated permissions and HSM authorization. Every detokenization call is logged as an audit event. Access is restricted to svc-payment-api for payment processing only. POST /rotate - Rotate a token (create new token for same card). Request body: {old_token: string}. Response 200: {new_token: string, old_token_expires_at: string}. Old token remains valid for 24 hours to allow in-flight transactions to complete. HSMClient.generate_key creates a new encryption key for the rotated token. GET /tokens/{token_id}/metadata - Get token metadata without exposing card data. Response 200: {token:

es a new encryption key for the rotated token. GET /tokens/{token_id}/metadata - Get token metadata without exposing card data. Response 200: {token: string, card_last_four: string, card_brand: string, created_at: string, last_used_at: string, status: string}. Security. All endpoints require mTLS authentication with service certificates from vault.mfs.internal. Detokenization requires additional HSM-backed authorization. All operations are logged to mfs_audit_db for PCI DSS compliance. Card data is encrypted with AES-256-GCM via HSM-managed keys. Schemas. Token: {token, card_last_four, card_brand, created_at, expires_at, status}. TokenStatus enum: active, expired, revoked, rotated.",

Service: mfs-kyc-engine deployed on mfs-kyc-pod-01 in namespace mfs-fraud. Database: mfs_customers_db on pghost-prod-03.mfs.internal (document_verifications, identity_checks, sanctions_hits, liveness_results tables). Service account: svc-kyc-engine. Endpoints. POST /verifications - Submit

ent_verifications, identity_checks, sanctions_hits, liveness_results tables). Service account: svc-kyc-engine. Endpoints. POST /verifications - Submit a document for identity verification. Request body: {customer_id: string, document_type: string (passport, drivers_license, national_id), document_image_front: string (base64), document_image_back: string (base64, optional for passport), country: string (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)}.
